tools.name: remind_add
tools.title: Set a reminder
tools.description: A quick reminder: the message as a banner at the top of this desktop's screen, with a sound, in so many minutes (up to a week) or at a time of day, as the launcher's Tools › Remind sets one. It stays until dismissed, also under Do Not Disturb. It waits over a logout or a restart; one that came due meanwhile is told at the next login. For a thing to do with a date, a task is better, and for a time with others a calendar event.

when.title: When
when.description: Minutes from now (15, 90m, 1h30m; up to a week), or a time of day (22:45: the next one, tomorrow's once today's has passed)

message.title: Message
message.description: What the notification says, short. Without it: Reminder

tools.name: remind_list
tools.title: Reminders waiting
tools.description: The quick reminders still to come (remind_add's and the launcher's Tools › Remind), soonest first: id, at (ISO 8601), clock (HH:MM), minutes_left and message.

tools.name: remind_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a reminder
tools.description: Takes a waiting reminder away before it's due, by its id from remind_list.
